description: This file contains the Hibernate implementation of the Alert Data Access Object (DAO) for OpenMRS, providing methods to save, retrieve, delete, and query alerts from a database using Hibernate ORM. It implements the AlertDAO interface, handling alert-related database operations with Hibernate sessions and criteria queries.

classes.name: HibernateAlertDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the AlertDAO interface for managing alerts in the database.

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Saves or updates an Alert object in the database.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an Alert by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAlert
methods.description: Deletes an Alert from the database.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all alerts, optionally including expired ones.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves alerts for a specific user, with options to include read and expired alerts.
